title: Build and run local AlchLang domains
purpose: Turn explicit textual AlchLang source into deterministic local artifacts and execute authorized actions through bounded injected adapters.
inputs: UTF-8 Markdown containing one explicit alchlang code block
runtime facts, actor identity, authority grants and selected adapter registry
outputs: deterministically rendered TypeScript and JSON artifacts
local action result and emitted-event record
policies: Text syntax maps explicit tokens to carrier semantics and never infers owners or authority from names.
Build writes only below the selected output directory and requires force for replacement.
Actions execute only after rule, permission and authority checks pass.
Database and HTTP behavior is available only through explicitly injected bounded adapters.
Legacy predicate identifiers require an explicit executable registry; identifier spelling is never executable meaning.
claim_ceiling: Candidate local construction and execution capability only; no canonical language admission, external effect authority, publication, release or deployment.
